name: Shinomichi Haruka
source:
Second year student, Extreme Beach Volleyball Member

She is [url=/c84172]Yukari's[/url] partner at the Extreme Beach Volleyball Club. she is always thinking of her and want to be more than just her partner. She gets jealous with the [url=/c83707]protagonist[/url] when Yukari speaks so candidly with him.
